description:
## Kero309x Patches 0.1.2 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. Anghami 8.0.28 is the first registered target on the Morphe framework.

- First release built by `buildAndroid`, so the bundle carries `classes.dex` and can be loaded by Morphe Manager. Releases `0.1.0` and `0.1.1` were built without DEX and only serve Morphe Desktop.
- First signed release. The `.mpp` carries an Ed25519 signature in its `MorpheSig1` trailer, and `patches-bundle.json` publishes the matching `public_key`, so a bundle altered after publication can be rejected.
- No behaviour change to any of the twenty patches.

### Verification

- 20 patches, all default-enabled.
- 20/20 PASS against the stock 8.0.28 build (fingerprint, apply and recompile).
- Published artefact re-checked after the release: 112 entries, `classes.dex` of 99,480 bytes, a signature whose public key equals the committed `morphe-signing.pub`, and a SHA-256 matching the value below.
- No device or emulator is available yet, so there is no runtime behavioural verification.

### Install

Add `Kero309x/Kero309x-Patches` as a patch source in Morphe Manager and enable pre-releases, or install the attached `Kero309x-Patches-0.1.2.mpp` directly.
